errors.configuration: The configuration file is incomplete or invalid
errors.missing_token: No token: add one to the token file
errors.storage: The configuration could not be read
errors.timeout: Home Assistant did not answer in time
errors.unauthorized: Home Assistant refused the token (401 or 403)

invalid.entity: An entity identifier holds a domain and an object identifier, such as light.living_room
invalid.refresh: The refresh period must be a whole number of at least 10 seconds
invalid.too_many_entities: There are too many entities (at most 24)
invalid.url: The URL must start with https:// or http:// and hold no ?, # or @

main.no_entities: No entities to show: add some to configuration.json.
main.not_configured: No configuration: write configuration.json and a token file.
